title: The neighbourhood is drawn on its own grey layers, locked but for the footprints
evidence: GordiumStart with 106 Ithaca Rd looked up (recorded answers) drew {'Context': 0, 'Parcels': 229, 'Streets': 38, 'Buildings': 322, 'Notes': 6} on Gordium::Context's sublayers in their greys; locked: {'Context': False, 'Parcels': True, 'Streets': True, 'Buildings': False, 'Notes': True}; all visible; said: "Neighbourhood drawn: 229 parcels, 38 streets, 322 buildings (footprints from 2014).".
rhino_part: Real Rhino 8 layer behaviour: here a parent's IsVisible giving sublayers its lock, a locked parent locking its sublayers' objects, and Delete/Select refusing locked objects are MODELLED (fakerhino.py), not proven. Also that the layers look grey in the viewport.

title: Every note lies inside the neighbourhood square (the sources wrapped, at most 60 characters a line)

title: The sources note is small: its own scale 1, 2.5 ft text, at most 4.25 ft a line as displayed

rhino_part: The displayed line height (Rhino's annotation scaling and text layout) at most 4.25 ft a line.

Whether Rhino 8 really deletes under a locked "Gordium" opened parent-first, and really leaves Grade locked after the parent's IsVisible, is the round-5 question only Rhino answers.
